name: Washington
note: Washington has no state income tax on wages; take-home pay is federal income tax and FICA plus the state payroll programs below.

items.label: Paid Family and Medical Leave
items.note: Total premium 1.2% of wages up to the Social Security wage base ($192,300 in 2027); employees pay 70.7% of it (the employer pays 29.3%).

items.label: WA Cares long-term care
items.note: 0.58% of all wages. Employees with approved exemptions do not pay it.

obtainedFrom.title: paidleave.wa.gov updates
obtainedFrom.note: Read 26 Nov 2026: "Starting Jan. 1, 2027: The premium rate will be 1.2%. The rate for 2026 is 1.13%. Employers will pay 29.3% of the total premium and employees will pay 70.7%." 1.2% × 70.7% = 0.8484% of wages.
